For deeper use in data curation work, it is worth checking the appendix details on URL mapping, label granularity, and the limitation that 2025 control labels are projected backward onto earlier years.190:T456,The method relies on a useful property of BPE: training with N merges implicitly defines a nested sequence of tokenizers T1...TN, where each step differs by exactly one merge. This turns merge-budget selection into choosing a model along a one-dimensional path. For each tokenizer, the paper fits a unigram model over tokenized data and scores it with information criteria that trade off log-likelihood against model complexity. The study includes AIC, BIC, two-part MDL, and refined MDL/COMP-style criteria, plus entropy-based filtering baselines. This is different from standard BPE, which greedily constructs merges by frequency; here the merge list is assumed given, and the problem is post hoc selection of an optimal subset. A second ingredient is synthetic text augmentation: when the adaptation corpus is small, unigram and bigram estimates are sparse, so the authors generate synthetic text from the original data to improve distributional estimates before computing the selection criteria. The role of augmentation is not downstream training, but more stable token statistics for tokenizer selection.191:T53d,UltraData-Code is organized into four connected layers:
- L0 (repository archive): defines the repository boundary and preserves provenance (metadata, directory structure, file paths, retained revision). Only the latest commit on the default branch is kept to fix a stable snapshot.
- L1 (standardized natural code): scalable filtering/cleaning/normalization plus near-deduplication. The pipeline routes processing by 80 language categories and 160 extensions (including special filenames like Makefile), using extension-specific cleaning profiles and extension-partitioned near-dedup.
- L2 (algorithmic selection): a language-adaptive selection framework to extract algorithmically relevant, transferable implementations. It combines file-role supervision (to distinguish implementation vs tests/config/docs, etc.) with language-specific heuristic cues, trains relevance/quality models, reuses precomputed semantic embeddings to reduce cost, and applies role/quality constraints during selection.
- L3 (task-oriented synthesis): converts each L2-selected implementation into a structured programming exercise, generating aligned fields (task statement, analysis, solution, and test candidates). The emphasis is implementation-grounded synthesis to preserve computational intent and reduce drift compared to free-form LLM-generated problems.192:T808,The method is built under a strict black-box assumption. The attacker does not access weights or internal logits, and instead relies on crafted inputs and observable outputs. The main finding is that individual signals are weak, but a combination of multiple weak signals can support useful dataset inference.

The pipeline has three parts. First, the paper formalizes two audit settings: external audits, where a data owner suspects unauthorized use of a dataset and only has the suspect dataset plus limited auxiliary data; and internal audits, which are closer to release-time risk assessment. Second, it designs TFM-specific signals around the in-context prediction mechanism. Because TFM outputs depend on the provided context dataset, the auditor can manipulate the support set, subsample the suspect dataset, perturb labels or columns, alter context-query matching, and then observe changes in confidence, loss-like quantities, ranking behavior, or output stability. A central point in the paper is that each signal alone tends to have limited separation power, partly because pre-training pipelines weaken direct evidence through augmentation and task reformulation. Third, the paper aggregates these weak observables into a dataset-level inference model: for each candidate dataset, it extracts a feature vector of black-box signals and trains a meta-classifier to predict whether the dataset was in the pre-training corpus.

A useful conceptual contribution is the distinction between TFM auditing and prior dataset inference work in LLMs or self-supervised vision. In TFMs, the context dataset actively participates in prediction, so the auditor can probe training-related behavior by constructing different context-query configurations. This is not a direct reuse of existing membership inference methods; it exploits the conditional structure of in-context learning. Another important result is interpretive rather than algorithmic: detectability is tied much more strongly to the nature of the pre-training corpus than to raw parameter count.193:T7bc,The experiments are organized around understanding detectability rather than just maximizing attack accuracy.

First, individual signals are generally weak. The paper evaluates a broad set of candidate black-box observables and shows that, in isolation, they usually provide only limited evidence about whether a dataset was used in pre-training. This matters because it frames the attack as an accumulation of subtle biases rather than exploitation of a single obvious vulnerability.

Second, combining signals substantially improves performance. The paper reports that multi-signal inference can accurately identify training datasets for some strong contemporary TFMs, which is the main practical result.

Third, the factor analysis is especially informative. The dominant driver of detectability is pre-training data composition. Real datasets and real-derived synthetic datasets leave stronger dataset-level traces, whereas models trained on prior-synthetic data leak much less, except when the number of pre-training datasets is very small. By contrast, increasing model size alone has little effect on detectability. This is an important correction to the naive intuition that larger models are automatically more vulnerable.

Fourth, the paper studies additional factors on both the data and model sides, including suspect dataset properties, context construction choices, and differences across TFM training setups. The consistent message is that attack success depends on whether context manipulation can reliably expose training-related biases.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so precise AUROC, accuracy, parameter counts, and corpus sizes cannot be quoted reliably here. Still, the experimental structure is clear: compare signals one by one, compare single-signal versus multi-signal inference, compare real / real-derived synthetic / prior-synthetic pre-training, and test whether scaling model size changes detectability.194:T50a,For a fast read, focus on four parts.

Start with the problem setup. The distinction between external and internal audits clarifies the threat model and what information the auditor is assumed to have.

Then read the method section that categorizes the signals. The key is not to memorize every signal name, but to understand how the paper exploits the in-context structure of TFMs: some probes modify the support set, some perturb labels or features, and some measure output stability or confidence under controlled input changes. This is where most of the methodological value sits.

Next, inspect the experiments comparing single-signal and multi-signal inference, and the ablations that contrast data composition with model size. Those figures carry the most durable conclusions.

Finally, read the discussion and limitations. Three follow-up questions are worth attention: whether stronger augmentation or task randomization would suppress the attack, how much the method depends on the richness of API outputs, and whether similar ideas transfer to text ICL models, code models, or multimodal in-context learners.

If reading in depth, spend time on the mechanism behind why single signals are weak but their combination works. That is more valuable than the final attack score alone.195:T603,SPLIT models success as:
P(success) = P(at least one correct candidate exists) × P(it is selected | it exists),
and explicitly models the second term (selection), not just coverage.

Section 3 derives exact success formulas for two selectors widely used:
1) Uniform selection among verifier-accepted candidates.
2) Argmax selection by verifier score.

The formulas incorporate verifier true/false accept rates and three correlation sources observed in practice:
- Heterogeneous task difficulty (per-task solve rates vary widely).
- Shared blind spots across generators, modeled via a Gaussian copula.
- Correlated repeated verifier calls for the same candidate, modeled via a candidate-level acceptance propensity.

Section 4 estimates these ingredients from a small labeled pilot using empirical Bayes, including variants where verifier accuracy depends on task difficulty (to avoid biased pooling).

A planner then searches over configurations—generator choices, sample counts, verifier calls, thresholds—under a cost budget to maximize predicted success. The paper also provides a regret guarantee tied to differential (not absolute) forecast error (Proposition 4), explaining why approximate calibration can still yield near-optimal allocations.

Section 6.3 turns several empirical “folk observations” into testable mechanisms/conditions, including when majority-of-k re-verification reduces attainable precision and why false-positive rates can rise with stronger generators due to threshold calibration in scored verifiers.196:T4df,Across five allocation problems (real or simulated verifiers) plus an agentic threshold-selection setting, SPLIT’s chosen configuration is within 0.02–0.8 percentage points of the hindsight-optimal allocation on held-out tasks.

Fixed heuristics—“use the strongest model,” “sample more than you verify,” “add more judges,” and an adaptation of compute-optimal exponent rules—each lose at least 2.5 points in some realistic setting.

Concrete correlation/pathology evidence reported:
- On MATH, majority voting over Llama-3-8B-Instruct stays around ~43% while coverage reaches ~98%.
- Difficulty heterogeneity: an average 27% solve rate would imply 96% coverage at 10 tries under i.i.d., but measured per-problem rates yield 61%, with 44/128 problems almost never solved.
- Cross-generator correlation: per-problem solve rates of Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Gemma-7B correlate at 0.80.
- Judge correlation: about one-third of wrong MATH-500 answers fool at least 6 of 8 LLM judges.

Engineering/reproducibility: uses publicly released samples/verdicts, re-executes 80,403 CodeContests programs locally, reports paired significance tests, and includes a long-horizon evaluation on SWE-Bench Verified with a pool of 175 agent systems.197:T580,The work first documents three forms of model-specific bias. Generation bias is measured under repeated sampling: when self-consistency fails, wrong samples often collapse onto the same dominant wrong answer rather than spreading across alternatives. The paper quantifies this with C_q, the fraction of incorrect samples assigned to the most frequent wrong answer, under SC@20 on benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond. Initial-answer persistence bias is measured by asking the model for a direct answer first and then asking it to reason before answering; the post-reasoning answer remains strongly tied to the initial prediction, especially when the initial prediction is wrong. Longer-reasoning preference bias appears in self-evaluation: when the model judges its own earlier and later answers, it overwhelmingly prefers the later, more elaborate one. In disagreement cases, the later-stage answer is selected more than 95% of the time, often with high confidence even when it is wrong. Dia, the proposed method, uses these observations directly. It compares an intermediate-stage prediction with the final-stage prediction. If they agree, the final answer is returned. If they disagree, a small heterogeneous solver panel answers the question independently without seeing either candidate. The final decision is made by answer-level aggregation rather than by a judge reading candidate rationales.198:T43f,The theory starts from a fixed window W. Each agent first pays for the question and peer messages, denoted H, plus a small fixed overhead c. The remaining reasoning budget is g = W - H - c. Instead of assigning each agent a fixed probability of being correct, the paper models ability as a function of g: too little budget prevents the agent from reaching an answer, more budget improves accuracy, and the gains eventually saturate. This ability curve is fitted with a thinking-gain function φ using held-out calibration data. Votes are then aggregated with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. The framework defines a per-answer margin δ, group accuracy A(n), an effective sample size n_eff, and a synergy index S(n)=δ√n_eff. With single-agent cap sweeps and an initial estimate of error correlation, the model predicts an interior optimal debate size n* in closed form, without running a full grid over debate configurations. The same accounting extends to heterogeneous model sets, where the rule selects both how many models to include and which models to use.199:T5b3,The approach is intentionally end-to-end and depends on three coupled steps:
1) Axis decomposition and per-axis scaling fits (Sec. 4): formalize the training corpus as a tensor over tasks T, environments E, and trajectories per (t,e) cell. Define cardinalities DT=|T|, DE=|E|, and a trajectory axis Dτ capturing sampling density/volume, plus a reward-density control knob. Fit independent power-law exponents αT, αE, ατ by varying one axis while controlling others.
2) Pricing synthesis with a common ruler (Sec. 5): use the real-data scaling laws to convert synthetic data into “real-equivalent” units. Introduce κ∈[0,1] as an axis-specific discount (effectiveness of synthetic vs real) and identify a critical synthetic-to-real ratio r* where performance degradation/collapse begins. Reported thresholds are strongly ordered: rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, with a mechanistic interpretation tied to how strongly each axis is grounded by external truth.
3) Compute-optimal allocation (Sec. 6): solve a constrained optimization over model size N and axis budgets (DE,DT,Dτ) under total compute C, incorporating synthesis costs/discounts. Derive closed-form scaling prescriptions: DE*∝C^0.34, DT*∝C^0.27, Dτ*∝C^0.13, N*∝C^0.26. Further refine the environment axis into world diversity vs environment-structure diversity, yielding αW>αV≈αT>ατ, which maps cleanly to engineering choices (build new worlds vs expand API/structure).19a:T4a0,Coverage is designed to test robustness across models, algorithms, and domains rather than a single benchmark:
- Models/algorithms: Qwen3-4B/8B/14B; both GRPO and PPO.
- Domains: five domains including math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool-use.
- Total: 21 experimental settings (as stated).
Key quantitative takeaways:
1) A direct failure case for scalar “token” scaling: two Qwen3-8B runs with identical total tokens and FLOPs but different (task, environment, trajectory) allocations differ by 14 percentage points in success rate.
2) Stable exponent ordering across settings: αE>αT>ατ; with environment split, αW>αV≈αT>ατ.
3) Synthetic mixture limits: collapse thresholds rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, implying trajectory-heavy synthetic rollouts are the most fragile.
4) The compute-optimal allocation derived from fitted laws is validated at a held-out compute scale, supporting the claim that the fitted exponents are predictive for budget planning.
A practical interpretation consistent with the reported numbers: once coverage over (t,e) cells is decent, additional trajectory resampling yields the lowest marginal gains and hits synthetic bias issues earliest.19b:T44a,Read it in the order that matches the dependency chain:
- Start with the Introduction and the motivating figure showing a 14pp gap under equal tokens/FLOPs; it clarifies why allocation, not quantity, is the bottleneck.
- Spend most time on Sec. 4 (definitions + fitting protocol). The credibility of everything else hinges on how DT/DE/Dτ and reward density are operationalized and controlled.
- Then Sec. 5 for κ and r*: check how “collapse” is detected, what metrics are used, and whether the estimation is robust to training noise.
- Sec. 6 for the optimization and the derived exponents; verify how synthesis costs/discounts enter constraints and why the resulting powers take those values.
- Finally, focus on the environment split (world vs structure). This is the most actionable part for teams deciding between generating new interactive worlds versus enriching existing environments.
Deep-dive prompts: whether reward density behaves consistently across domains; and whether common RL practices that emphasize more rollouts are implicitly spending budget on the least efficient axis.19c:T882,文章研究的是 prelude–recurrent–coda 架构：前置层 P 和后置层 C 各执行一次，中间共享的 recurrent block R 重复执行 T 次。总非 embedding 参数写成 N = N_once + N_rec，其中 N_once 对应只跑一次的部分，N_rec 对应循环块。训练时允许前向执行 T 个 loops，但只对最后 B 个 loops 反向传播；前 T-B 个 loops 在 no-grad 下执行。作者的目标是建立一个统一 scaling law，把 N、训练 token 数 D、前向 loops T、反向 loops B 对 loss 的影响放进同一个公式里。

核心建模思想是“effective parameters”。作者不直接把 loop 数当成一个额外离散超参，而是把循环带来的收益映射成一个等效参数量 N_eff：即在相同 token 预算下，一个非 looped 模型若要达到同样 loss，需要多大参数量。这个映射有两个关键性质。其一，完整训练的 loops 会增加 N_eff，但边际收益递减；也就是从 1 loop 到 2 loops 的收益大于从 8 loops 到 9 loops。其二，truncated BPTT 会对这种 loop 增益打折，折扣大小由 B/T 决定，而不是简单地把未反传的 loops 当作“免费深度”。这使得 forward depth 和 backward credit assignment 被放进同一框架。

从摘要和正文可见，作者做了近 600 次训练，规模覆盖 58M 到 919M non-embedding 参数，训练 token/parameter 比跨越三个数量级，前向 loops 最多到 16，并独立扫描 T 和 B。然后他们拟合统一损失律，并用它做两类优化：一类是在给定前向 loop 数时，判断是否该截断；另一类是在 T 和 B 都可自由选择时，求固定训练算力下的最优配置。

这篇文章和已有工作的区别主要有两点。Schwethelm 等是对不同 truncation recipe 分别拟合 scaling law，不能直接联合优化 T 和 B；Parcae 虽研究 backward-loop 数，但在 scaling 分析里把 B 固定成 T 的一半。这里则把前向和反向 loop 数都作为一等变量，并通过 N_eff 把它们与模型大小、数据量统一起来。这样得到的不是“某个 recipe 的经验结论”，而是一个可用于算力分配的决策模型。19d:T728,The model family is the prelude–recurrent–coda architecture. A prelude P and coda C are executed once per token, while a shared recurrent block R is executed T times. Non-embedding parameters are decomposed as N = N_once + N_rec, where N_once belongs to the once-run components and N_rec to the shared recurrent block. During training, the model may execute T forward loops but backpropagate only through the last B loops; the earlier T-B loops are run without gradient tracking.

The key modeling idea is effective parameters. Instead of treating loop count as just another discrete hyperparameter, the paper maps the gain from looping into an equivalent non-looped parameter count N_eff: the size of a standard model that would achieve the same loss at the same token budget. This gives a compact way to express two facts. Fully trained loops increase N_eff with diminishing returns, and truncated BPTT discounts that increase. In other words, forward depth and backward credit assignment are coupled through a single quantity rather than analyzed separately.

Empirically, the paper runs nearly 600 training jobs, spanning 58M to 919M non-embedding parameters, three orders of magnitude in training tokens per parameter, and up to 16 forward loops. It independently varies T and B across model sizes and token budgets, then fits a unified loss law. That law is used for two optimization problems: whether truncation helps when T is fixed, and what the optimal T/B allocation is when both are free.

Relative to prior work, this is the main methodological advance. Earlier studies either fit separate laws for different truncation recipes or fixed B as a simple function of T. Here, forward and backward loop counts are both first-class variables, and their effects are integrated with model size and data scale through N_eff.19e:T75b,There are four main empirical takeaways. First, the unified scaling law fits the data well enough to jointly explain the effects of model size, token count, forward loops, and backward loops. The loop benefit appears as an effective-parameter gain, and truncation appears as a discount on that gain. Because the fit is supported by nearly 600 runs rather than a small ablation grid, the conclusions carry more weight.

Second, when the forward loop count T is prescribed, truncation can indeed be beneficial. The saved backward compute can be reallocated to a larger model and more training tokens, and that can outweigh the discounted loop gain. This recovers and explains the positive truncation results reported in earlier work.

Third, once T and B are jointly optimized, the conclusion flips: the fitted law favors full BPTT. Intuitively, if a configuration spends compute on many forward loops but trains only the last few, one can often remove some forward loops and use the freed compute to increase backward coverage until all remaining loops are trained. Under the fitted law, that yields higher N_eff and lower loss. The paper supports this not only with the fitted law but also with matched-compute experiments.

Fourth, the compute-allocation analysis gives practical rules. If model size is fixed, increasing loop count is a valid way to raise effective parameters, but the optimal loop count grows only slowly with compute; most extra compute should still go to more training tokens. If model size is also free, the leading-FLOP approximation favors a non-looped model overall, and among looped models the best setting is two fully trained loops. In experiments, a 2-loop full-BPTT model nearly matches the compute-optimal non-looped model at equal training compute while using substantially fewer non-embedding parameters, and with a bit more compute it surpasses it.19f:T6c8,The method, CES, treats CoT generation as a sequence of chunks. At each step t, the model has a running prediction f_t(x) and a scalar signal s_t, such as confidence, answer stability, or another trajectory statistic. The paper is intentionally signal-agnostic: it does not propose a new confidence signal, but a new stopping policy that consumes existing ones.

The key tool is the e-process, a sequential evidence accumulator with anytime-valid guarantees. Informally, if a null hypothesis about lack of sufficient evidence holds, the e-process should not grow too large at any stopping time; if it does, one can reject the null while controlling false alarms via Ville’s inequality. This removes the need for held-out calibration.

CES runs two e-processes on the same signal:
1. a commit stream, which tracks the position of the signal relative to its slow trend and decides when there is enough evidence to return the current answer;
2. an abstain stream, which tracks signed velocity and decides when progress is weak, stalled, or moving in the wrong direction, so the system should stop and defer to a fallback.

A notable design choice is that the two streams are anti-correlated by construction. Rising signal supports commit and suppresses abstain; deteriorating signal does the opposite. This avoids relying on a single absolute mapping from signal value to correctness. The decision is instead based on trajectory dynamics.

The main limitation is also clear: the guarantee is at the signal level, not a direct correctness guarantee on the task. If the underlying signal is poorly aligned with answer correctness, CES cannot fix that. Its contribution is to consume a given signal more robustly than threshold-based rules.1a0:T548,The main empirical claim is that CES matches or exceeds the token-accuracy Pareto of Conformal Thinking across multiple model-dataset combinations while using zero calibration data. It also transfers more cleanly across deployment cells, where a cell refers to a model, dataset, prompt format, or token-budget configuration. This matters because calibration-based methods need per-cell validation data, and their guarantees do not survive distribution or horizon shifts.

The evaluation explicitly accounts for probing cost, which is a good design choice. Many early-exit methods understate compute by ignoring the cost of monitoring intermediate states. The paper focuses on the tradeoff curve between token usage and accuracy rather than raw accuracy alone.

The most informative experimental points are:
1. with the same underlying signal, CES is more stable than thresholded or calibrated stopping rules;
2. alpha keeps a consistent interpretation across models and datasets, unlike empirical thresholds;
3. the dual commit/abstain construction reduces both premature wrong commits and wasted reasoning on hopeless instances.

The excerpt does not include full tables, so precise gains cannot be quoted reliably here. But the paper’s empirical target is clear: competitive token-efficiency without per-cell calibration, especially under transfer.1a1:T4da,For a skim-level read, start with the motivation rather than the math. The introduction clearly explains why threshold-based early stopping is brittle: thresholds do not transfer, calibration needs held-out data, and guarantees break when the deployment horizon or signal dynamics shift.

In the method section, focus on three points:
1. how the scalar signal s_t is defined and why the framework is signal-agnostic;
2. the intuition behind the commit and abstain streams;
3. what Ville’s inequality actually guarantees, and what it does not.

In the experiments, prioritize:
- fairness of the comparison with Conformal Thinking, especially whether probing cost is included;
- cross-cell transfer results;
- token-accuracy curves under different alpha values;
- any ablations comparing single-stream vs dual-stream designs or different primary signals.

If you are thinking about deployment, keep one practical question in mind while reading: where does the underlying signal come from, and how noisy is it? CES is an upper-layer policy, so its ceiling is largely determined by the quality of that signal. Around 25 minutes should be enough for the main ideas; more time is only needed if you want to reproduce the statistical construction.1a2:T64b,BOSS is a training-free online policy rather than a new model. The main contribution is the budget-faithful decision framework. Each model call incurs prompt-plus-completion token cost. Generation calls use a cap L_gen, judge calls use L_judge, and before every call the policy checks worst-case feasibility against the remaining budget. This guarantees that no adaptive trajectory can exceed the hard per-instance cap. That accounting detail is central, because many prior systems either ignore selection overhead or count only completion tokens while omitting the repeated prompt cost of judge calls.

After each generated candidate, BOSS chooses among three actions: return, generate again, or adjudicate. The decision uses three ingredients. First, consensus-based termination stops early when the observed answers are already stable enough. Second, a novelty-based switch detects when additional sampling is no longer producing meaningfully new answer hypotheses, at which point the marginal value of generation drops. Third, budget-feasible pairwise judging spends the remaining budget on answer-level comparisons among candidate representatives.

The paper appears to avoid expensive full ranking over all traces. Instead, it relies on answer grouping, representative selection, and repeated randomized judging to approximate a good final choice under budget. A particularly strong design choice is the identical-candidate-pool control: the authors hold Stage-I candidates fixed and vary only the selector, which isolates the contribution of adjudication and allocation from candidate-generation quality.1a3:T5be,The experiments cover two Llama-3.1 model sizes and four reasoning benchmarks. Under the common hard-cap setting, BOSS achieves the best accuracy in 22 of 24 model-task-budget cells. One representative result reported in the paper is at Llama-3.1-8B with a 4k-token budget: a development-tuned fixed generation-selection split reaches 59.3 macro average, BOSS reaches 60.5, and removing the novelty-triggered switch drops performance to 59.0. That suggests the online transition from generation to adjudication is a real source of gain rather than a minor heuristic.

The strongest evidence comes from the same-candidate-pool experiment. Using exactly the same Stage-I candidate pools, changing only the selector raises macro accuracy from 58.4 to 60.3 with randomized repeated judging, and to 60.5 with the full BOSS selector. This is important because it shows the improvement is not merely due to better candidate generation. Selection and allocation contribute independently.

The paper also reports comparisons against Adaptive-Consistency and TALE-EP under the same strict token ledger, realized-token analyses rather than nominal-budget-only reporting, transition statistics, hyperparameter sensitivity, and paired per-instance tests. It separates three notions of efficiency: equal data, equal wall-clock time, and equal tuning effort. The main result is clean: Muon is consistently better in sample efficiency on the tested small models, but its reference single-GPU implementation is expensive enough that AdamW wins the time-normalized comparison on the language workloads.","importance":"The useful lesson for pretraining is that optimizer comparisons need more than loss-versus-token curves. A matrix optimizer such as Muon can reduce loss per token while losing on loss per second if the update path is slow. This matters for LLM pretraining because the practical decision depends on kernel quality, distributed implementation, parameter routing, and communication cost. The experiment is small and single-device, so it should not be treated as a large-scale ranking. Its stronger contribution is the evaluation protocol: paired seeds, fixed tuning budget, validation AUC over trajectories, timing attribution, and frozen test evaluation.","technical_approach":"$b","experiments":"At equal data, Muon lowers validation-loss AUC on all four workloads. The mean crossover appears at 4.8% and 3.0% of the language training horizons, while both vision runs have already crossed by the first 1% evaluation point. weakness of low-rank gradient-subspace optimization for LLM training: the principal gradient subspace is not static. Methods in the GaLore family rely on the observation that gradients are largely concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace, but they usually refresh that subspace only periodically, often via expensive SVD recomputation, implicitly assuming it stays valid for a while. Other methods, such as OSD, add a secondary optimization loop to chase the moving subspace. The paper argues, with explicit empirical evidence, that after warm-up the gradient subspace in LLM training typically drifts slowly and smoothly rather than jumping erratically. If that is true, then the right problem is not repeated cold-start estimation but online tracking. 的对应列作为一个耦合通道组，并分配一个 allocation μ_j^ell ∈ [0,1]。所有 block、所有 hidden channels 共享一个全局预算 K，满足 sum_{ell,j} μ_j^ell = K。给定 allocation 后，BMuon 在 Muon 的谱范数约束内部加入对角重加权；然后再全局选择 allocation，使一阶 loss decrease 最大。这样，通道之间不是各层独立竞争，而是在全模型 MLP 通道池中竞争同一个预算。理论上，BMuon oracle 等价于某个诱导范数 Ω_{α,K} 下的归一化最速下降。α 控制通道重加权强度，K 控制可用通道预算。α=0 或 K=N 时退化为 Muon；α=1 时，单位球是至多 K 个耦合通道上 operator-norm-bounded updates 的凸包；α=K=1 时接近 out","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-16T08:41:25Z","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2610_23145.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很基础的问题：能不能在 Transformer 上用“局部学习”替代标准端到端反向传播，同时把显存占用显著降下来，而精度不要掉得太多。标准 backprop 的瓶颈不只是算力，更是 activation 必须跨整网保存到反传结束，这让深层模型、长序列和大 batch 都直接受限。已有 local learning 方法往往用局部辅助损失训练每一层或每一块，但这些局部目标和全局任务梯度之间缺少严格对应，所以一旦网络变深，误差会快速累积。作者要解决的核心不是再设计一个经验上可用的 local loss，而是构造一种有明确梯度近似含义的局部替代：每个 block 只看本地激活，通过一个 proxy 去预测全局输出，再用 proxy 节省内存，而是从训练信号本身改写反传依赖。这个方向如果能继续成立，价值在三点。第一，它把“局部更新”从经验技巧推进到可分析的梯度估计框架，至少在深线性网络和残差占优的非线性网络里有理论支撑。第二，它对长上下文和深层 Transformer 的 memory wall 有直接相关性，因为 locality 的定义就是一次只保留一个 block 的激活。第三，它在 LLM Transformer 划分成多个 gradient-isolated blocks。第 l 个 block 的输入是 h_{l-1}，输出是 h_l。标准 backprop 需要通过后续所有 block 把最终损失对 h_l 的梯度传回来；ProxyProp 则给每个 block 额外挂一个本地 proxy network，输入 h_l，目标是预测全模型最终输出，训练信号来自对全局输出的蒸馏。然后该 block 的参数更新不再依赖真实下游网络的反传，而是把损失先对 proxy 输出求导，再经由 proxy 对 h_l 反传，得到对 block 参数的局部梯度估计。\n\n关键点不只是“加一个辅助头”，而是作者把 proxy 设计成对全局 Jacobian 的局部估计器。在线性网络里，若 proxy 是线性的，最优 Transformer，而不是任意深层非残差网络。\n\n训练流程上，block 在前向后即可立刻更新，不需要等待整网 backward，因此满足 decoupled / unlocked learning 的定义。内存节省来自两部分：一是不再保存整网 activation；二是每次只需保留单个 block 及其 proxy 的局部计算图。与传统 local loss 方法相比，区别在于 ProxyProp 的目标不是让每层直接完成分类或重建，而是逼近“如果继续经过后续网络，最终会对输出产生什么影响”。与 MeZO 这类零阶优化相比，ProxyProp 仍然使用梯度信息，只是梯度来自局部代理，因此在相近内存预算下通常更高效。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验分成两类。第一类是视觉 Transformer 上的监督学习，用来系统比较不同 block 划分下的 Existing MTP methods provide denser supervision and can support speculative decoding, but they are usually auxiliary by design: future-token losses are handled by horizon-specific heads attached to the backbone. This creates two issues. First, multi-horizon supervision reaches the backbone only indirectly, so the parameters responsible for next-token generation may not actually learn to plan further ahead. Second, deeper horizons are expensive: every extra prediction step adds modules and compute, which is why large-scale causal MTP often stops at a single draft token. ECHO asks whether future-token prediction can be turned from an auxiliary branch into a self-recursive use of the backbone itself, so that long-horizon supervision directly shapes the model and remains affordable.","importance":"For pretraining, the contribution is meaningful because it reframes MTP from an inference-oriented add-on into a training objective that can alter the backbone more directly. If the same parameters used for next-token generation are also trained to predict multiple future steps, then multi-horizon supervision is no longer mostly absorbed by side modules. That matters for representation learning, especially for reasoning and code, where longer-horizon structure is more important. A second contribution is practical: ECHO makes deeper causal supervision nearly parameter-free and keeps the average training overhead low through dynamic depth sampling. A third contribution is at the pretrain–inference interface. Since drafting is learned through recursive reuse of pretrained weights, the method removes the need for post-hoc drafter finetuning and supports depth extrapolation at inference. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2610_24736.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作研究的是：Muon 这类带正交化更新的优化器，在差分隐私训练里到底为什么能工作、什么时候能工作、以及它相对 DP-SGD / DP-Adam 的行为会发生什么变化。难点不在隐私会计本身，而在优化分析。DP 训练里每个样本梯度先被 clipping，再加高斯噪声，之后才进入动量与 Muon 的正交化步骤。clipping 会引入状态相关偏差，噪声会在每一步注入，动量会沿着不断变化的轨迹累积这些扰动，而 Muon 的非线性正交化又会进一步放大分析难度。已有很多 DP 非凸优化分析为了简化问题，会假设 per-example gradient 有统一上界，使 clipping 基本不生效；这与实际大模型训练并不贴近。作者要解决的核心问题，就是在 active clipping 真正发生时，给出对 Muon/更一般 momentum-LMO 方法的可解释理论，并检验这种理论是否能解释实际私有训练中的优化器表现。","importance":"对预训练研究的直接相关性中等，但对大模型训练方法研究有方法论价值。第一，它把 Muon 放进了 differential privacy 这个更苛刻的噪声环境里，帮助理解正交化更新到底依赖什么信号。第二，论文给出的关键结论不是“Muon 在 DP 下总是更好”，而是 clipping 的主效应常常只是对梯度做正比例缩放，而 LMO 类更新对这种缩放不敏感，真正影响优化的是改变方向的残差项。这一观察把 Muon、Scion、normalized SGD、sign 类方法放进同一分析框架，对理解非欧几里得更新在噪声和裁剪下的鲁棒性很有帮助。第三，实验结论也有现实意义：在 DP 训练里最优 batch size 往往比非私有训练大 1-2 个数量级，优化器优劣随 batch size 改变，而不是像非私有设置那样排序稳定。这提醒做私有预训练或受限数据训练的人，不能直接照搬非 DP recipe。","technical_approach":"方法上，作者提出 DP-Muon，但更重要的是分析框架。Muon 可被看成对矩阵参数的动量做近似正交化；从更抽象的角度，它属于 linear minimization oracle, LMO 驱动的更新。这个视角把 Muon、Scion、SignSGD、normalized SGD 统一起来：它们都可以理解为在某个范数球上的线性最小化方向选择。\n\n论文的关键理论观察是对期望裁剪梯度 μ(g)=E[clip_c(g+ξ)] 的分解。作者证明它可以写成沿真梯度 g 的正向缩放项，加上一个改变方向的残差项 r(g)。由于 LMO 对正比例缩放不敏感，即 LMO(λg)=LMO(g), λ>0，所以 clipping 带来的主导影响在经过 LMO 后会被“看不见”；真正进入优化误差的是方向残差，而这个残差由 centered gradient variance 控制。这个结论很重要，因为它避开了传统分析里对原始 per-example gradient 有界的强假设，也不要求 clipping threshold 随训练步数增长。\n\n在此基础上，作者给出 smooth nonconvex 目标下、任意有限维范数空间中的 private momentum-LMO 收敛界。误差项被拆成几部分：优化误差、动量跟踪误差、采样噪声、隐私噪声，以及 clipping floor。文中给出的 floor 是 ρ1 min{σ, σ^2/c} 量级，其中 ρ1 是从欧氏空间到目标对偶范数的转换常数。这个结果说明，经过 LMO 之后，clipped SGD 的紧界只多了一个几何转换代价，而不会因为正交化本身引入额外不可控项。固定噪声尺度时，得到约 O~(K^-1/4) 的收敛率；按 (ε, δ) 隐私预算校准噪声时，得到与经典 DP 结果一致的依赖关系。\n\n算法层面，DP-Muon 仍遵循标准 central example-level DP 流程：per-example clipping、加高斯噪声、求平均，再做动量和 Muon 正交化。隐私保证来自前半段，后半段属于 post-processing。论文的创新不在新的隐私机制，而在说明 Muon 这类后处理为何在 active clipping 下仍有合理优化性质。","experiments":"实验分理论验证和经验比较两部分。经验部分覆盖 CNN 与一个 3000 万参数的 GPT 语言模型，系统扫描 batch size、learning rate 和 momentum，并比较 DP-SGD、DP-Adam、DP-Muon 以及 Scion。最重要的发现有两个。第一，DP 设置下最优 batch size 相比非私有训练会增大 1 到 2 个数量级，这说明噪声主导区间下的 recipe 与常规训练明显不同。第二，优化器排序不再稳定依赖于 batch size：在非私有训练里 Muon 往往在各 batch size 都占优，但在 DP 下不是这样。\n\n具体结果上，CIFAR-10 上 DP-Muon 在除一个 batch size 外的所有设置里都达到最低平均 test loss，但在中等 batch size 区间，与其他方法的差距通常落在一个标准差内，说明优势存在但不夸张。语言建模任务上，DP-Muon 在小 batch size 下最好，接近最优 batch size 时 DP-Adam 更强，而大 batch The challenge is not privacy accounting but optimization. In DP training, clipping introduces a state-dependent bias, privacy noise is injected at every step, momentum accumulates these perturbations along a changing trajectory, and Muon then applies a nonlinear orthogonalization map. Much of the prior theory for private nonconvex optimization avoids this regime by assuming uniformly bounded per-example gradients, so clipping is effectively inactive. This work instead analyzes the realistic active-clipping regime and studies whether Muon, and more generally momentum-LMO methods, still have meaningful guarantees there.","importance":"Its direct relevance to large-scale pretraining is moderate, but it is useful for optimizer research around foundation models. The more important result is structural: clipping mainly acts like a positive rescaling of the gradient, and LMO-based updates are invariant to that rescaling; what matters is the residual that changes direction. That places Muon, Scion, normalized SGD, and sign-based methods into a common framework and clarifies their robustness under clipping and noise. With multinomial resampling, high-weight particles are duplicated and low-weight ones are dropped. ESS is a standard SMC diagnostic, but it measures weight imbalance, not how many distinct reasoning families remain alive. pretrain、私有数据增量训练、边端协同训练的人，这篇论文的价值在于提供了一个较完整的设计空间：哪些层需要全局共识，哪些局部结构可以因数据而异，以及这种划分如何影响聚合稳定性。","technical_approach":"方法叫 Optimal Hydra，核心对象是 Hydra-Net。整体流程分两步。\n\n第一步是 common layer selection。作者认为 Transformer 层承担较宏观的特征变换，如果客户端在这些层上分歧过大，会放大全局聚合时的结构不一致和 client drift。于是他们先让客户端协同识别一小部分“重要层”，这些层构成共享骨架，在这些层里不允许删除 attention head。文中这里借鉴并改造了已有的层重要性度量，使其能在联邦环境下估计哪些层更值得全体保留。这个设计不是简单追求参数公平，而是先固定一部分全局一致的表示通道，给后续异构训练留出稳定锚点。\n\n第二步是 individual head selection。对于其余“非重要层”，每个客户端根据本地数据，用梯度打分选择需要保留的 attention heads，其余 heads 被裁掉。这里的判断依据是 attention head 更偏任务相关、分布相关，适合做局部定制。这样得到的每个客户端子网共享同一层级骨架，但在部分层的 head 级结构上不同，形成 Hydra-Net。\n\n聚合方面，论文采用 direct index-mapping，把各客户端子网更新映射回全局模型原始参数索引后再聚合。这样避免了异构结构下常见的参数对齐困难。与早期静态/随机子网方法相比，区别有三点：一是子网不是随机给定，而是由数据驱动；二是结构异构主要落在 head 级，而不是任意粗暴裁剪；三是作者明确把“哪些参数必须被均衡训练”这个问题放到微调语境下重新审视，而不是沿用预训练结论。","experiments":"从全文可提炼出的主要结果有三类。\n\n第一类是总体效果。在较困难的 model-heterogeneous 条件下，Optimal Hydra 相比最强基线最高带来 42.5% 的性能提升。文中同时报告了资源收益：计算资源占用最高下降 32.0%，内存占用最高下降 29.3%。这说明它不是单纯用更多保留参数换性能，而是在更小子网下仍能提升效果。\n\n第二类是与子网选择策略相关的消融。作者比较了随机子网、静态子网、强调均匀参数训练的方案，以及他们的数据感知 Hydra-Net。结论是：在微调场景里，只要共享骨架足够稳定，局部不均匀的 head 保留并不会像预训练那样明显伤害收敛，反而因为更贴近本地分布而提升性能。这一点是全文最重要的经验结论。\n\n第三类是机制层面的分析。论文结合表示动态和 attention head 的任务相关性讨论，说明 common layers 更像全局共享表征通道，而 head 数字，而是“预训练结论在微调里失效”的实验支撑。","reading_guide":"这篇更适合泛读，但有两个点值得认真看。\n\n先看方法部分里 Hydra-Net selection 的两步设计，尤其是 common layer selection 和 individual head selection 为什么分开做。这里体现了作者对 Transformer It is an inference-time method rather than a new training objective, but it is relevant to diffusion and masked language modeling. The useful idea is to separate token reliability from schedule structure. Confidence says whether a prediction is safe to commit; pivot balance says how much sequential depth remains. That distinction may matter for future work on learned unmasking orders, order-aware diffusion training, or distillation of decoding policies.","technical_approach":"Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding operates on masked generation blocks. A block starts as all MASK tokens, and each iteration runs the model once to obtain distributions for unresolved positions. During the first K iterations, BPD performs confidence-based prefilling: high-confidence predictions are committed in parallel and can split the remaining masks into shorter contiguous intervals. After that, each active interval selects a pivot near its center, subject to a confidence threshold. The selected pivots are committed simultaneously, and each interval is split into left and right children. The theory shows that if every pivot leaves no child longer than a fixed fraction rho of the parent interval, with rho between 1/2 and 1, the sequential depth for an interval of length J is O(log(J+1)). KV-cache 压缩里最关键、也最容易被简化错的问题：删掉哪些 cache entry，不能只看单个 token 被删后的局部误差，因为注意力的 softmax 归一化会让所有保留下来的项一起变化。已有方法大多把“删除一个条目”的影响当成独立事件来打分，或者先选子集、再做 refit。这样会漏掉两个重要因素：一是删除决策之间存在耦合，二是剩余 value 可以通过补偿更新来吸收一部分误差。论文要解决的，就是如何在可承受的离线成本下，把“删除 + 补偿”联合起来做，而不是分成两个割裂步骤。","importance":"对基座研究本身，它不直接改变预训练范式，但对长上下文推理、固定知识库复用、企业文档/代码库问答这类高频场景很有现实意义。更具体地说，它把 offline KV compaction 从“启发式删点”推进到“近似联合优化”，这类思路对 会联动改变所有剩余项的权重，组合优化代价太高。作者用 calibration queries 近似真实使用时的 query 分布，在这些 query 上展开误差，并推导出一个二次型 surrogate。这个 surrogate 有两个关键性质：\n1. 对每个候选删除项，都能写出“在删除该项后，剩余 cache 应该如何做最优补偿更新”的闭式表达；\n2. 也能写出“做完最优补偿后，surrogate loss 增加多少”的闭式分数。\n\n于是算法流程不是传统的“给每个 entry 打一个静态分数”，而是迭代式 greedy elimination：每一步都在当前已补偿过的 cache 上，评估删掉某个 entry 后的最优补偿残差，选损失最小的那个删掉，再把对应补偿真正应用到剩余 entries。这样下一步的选择是在新的、已经被修复过的表示上进行。这个设计和 OBCache、CAOTE 这类单删点评分方法的区别，在于它把 compensation 放进 selection 过程，而不是放到 selection 之后。\n\n论文还给出 KV-Surgeon-fast 这样的加速版本，用更低的离线代价逼近完整方法。完整 pipeline 还包括最后的 joint refit，用于在选定保留集后进一步拟合 compacted cache。作者强调，refit 不是新东西，关键在于前面的选择阶段已经显式考虑了 refit/compensation 能力，因此 retained set 本身更合理。\n\n从机制上看，这篇工作的一个好点在于它不只关注 key 侧的 attention mass，也显式考虑 value redundancy。若某个 value 已经接近当前输出，即便它 attention weight 不低，删掉它的真实输出误差也可能有限。把 value 几何结构纳入 surrogate，是它优于纯 attention matching 类方法的重要原因。","experiments":"实验覆盖 QuALITY、LongHealth、Long Code Arena，模型既有 dense 也有 MoE，规模从 4B 到 30B，压缩比从 5x 到 100x，范围算比较完整。主结论很清楚：在几乎所有设置下，KV-Surgeon 都把 cost-accuracy frontier 往外推，尤其在高压缩比时更明显。\n\n文中给出的代表性数字包括：\n- 在全部实验平均上，100x 压缩时，问答准确率比已有最好方法高 4.3 个百分点；\n- 50x 压缩时，平均高 3.0 个百分点；\n- 在 50x、最大模型的示例里，已有最强基线 AM-HAK 达到 62.0% 准确率，pipeline 时间 138 秒/上下文；KV-Surgeon 达到 65.1%，时间 145 秒；KV-Surgeon-fast 达到 63.9%，但时间只要 54 秒。\n\n这些数字说明两件事。第一，收益主要出现在 aggressive compaction 区间；5x、10x 时提升较小，因为强基线本来就接近无损。第二，完整方法和 fast refit”更有效；\n- 在不同模型族、不同任务、不同压缩比下，趋势是否稳定。\n\n如果只看结论，最值得记的是：高压缩场景下，误差主要不是来自“删掉了高注意力 token”，而是来自“删掉后剩余表示没有被联合重整”。这也是它优于 prior art 的主要来源。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读，但如果你做长上下文推理优化，方法部分值得认真看。建议顺序是：\n1. 先看 the central difficulty in offline KV-cache compaction: deciding which cache entries to remove cannot be done with independent per-entry scores. In attention, deleting one entry changes the softmax normalization and therefore perturbs the weights of all surviving entries. Prior methods mostly score a candidate deletion while holding the rest of the cache fixed, or they select a subset first and only refit afterward. That misses both deletion interactions and the fact that surviving entries can compensate for removed ones. The paper asks how to make deletion and compensation a joint optimization problem while keeping the offline cost practical.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through the inference-efficiency side: long-context serving, repeated querying over fixed corpora, and memory-latency tradeoffs. The main contribution is methodological rather than benchmark-driven. It reframes offline KV compaction from heuristic ranking to approximate joint optimization, and that idea is useful beyond this exact setting. Similar reasoning may matter for attention approximation, token pruning, and any setting where local importance scores fail because the representation re-equilibrates after each decoding step, so the verification width M=Bd is dynamic. CUDA Graph replay prefers fixed launch topology and fixed argument shapes. Serving systems therefore face an awkward choice: pre-capture many shapes, capture new shapes on the request path, or pad every step to a maximum draft size.","importance":"The contribution is mainly on inference systems rather than pretraining, but it is useful for researchers who care about the deployment consequences of decoding algorithms. PolyGraph isolates a concrete systems mismatch between adaptive decoding policies and static CUDA Graphs. The mechanism shows how to keep graph replay stable while allowing the effective work region to vary. This is relevant to speculative decoding, continuous batching, tail-latency control, and kernel-level serving design.","technical_approach":"PolyGraph moves shape-dependent values out of captured graph arguments and into a persistent GPU-resident plan buffer. The system captures a maximum-grid CUDA Graph once. Before each replay, the runtime updates seven active int32 fields with a 28-byte asynchronous copy. Plan-aware Triton kernels read the active extent from device memory and guard tiles that fall outside it. Active tiles execute the original payload; inactive tiles only pay the cost of a metadata load and comparison. Compared with AllShapes, this avoids enumerating all B,d shapes. Compared with OnDemand capture, it avoids first-use latency spikes. Compared with MaxPad, it keeps the maximum graph but prevents padded token positions from running projections, normalization, and feed-forward work. The limitation is important: this contract works for custom kernels whose work can be guarded inside the kernel, but it does not automatically apply to opaque library calls with inaccessible launch shapes.","experiments":"The evaluation uses one NVIDIA H800 PCIe GPU, a 36-layer decode workload with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions, and custom Triton kernels without trained weights. The serving space covers B from 1 to 16 and draft length d from 1 to 8, giving 128 B,d pairs and 64 distinct M=Bd values. PolyGraph uses a single captured graph, while AllShapes uses 64 graphs and MaxPad uses 16. Pre-serving graph build time drops from 3915 ms to 93 ms. On trace-driven latency, PolyGraph matches the warmed reference: 17.7 ms versus 17.8 ms P50. OnDemand exposes first-use capture cost in the tail. MaxPad spends 31% of token work on padding. Fixed-draft controls support the proposed mechanism: when d equals dmax, PolyGraph differs from MaxPad by only 0.3%; when padding doubles the executed token count, PolyGraph reduces P99 latency by 18.7%.","reading_guide":"Skim the Introduction, PolyGraph Design, and Evaluation sections; 20 minutes is enough. Focus on the dynamic width M=Bd, the plan-buffer contract, and the fixed-draft controls that attribute the performance gain to avoided padded payload. delayed eviction。标准 prefill 通常是 token-major 或 sequence-major：整段 prompt 逐层向前传播，每层都同时持有整段序列的中间状态与该层 KV。TideKV 改成“按层完成、按块流过”。具体地，对某一层 l，prompt 被切成多个 chunk，系统让这一层依次处理所有 chunk，并把该层的未压缩 KV 历史持续累积；只有当该层已经看完完整 prompt 后，才在层末执行 KV 选择与压缩，然后释放该层完整 KV，再进入下一层。这样每一层做选择时仍然拥有 full-prompt-aware 的因果历史，不会像在线驱逐那样在后文到来前过早删除。\n\n为了让压缩步骤本身不重新制造大显存峰值，作者设计了 two-pass blockwise streaming top-k。第一遍按 key block Reposi","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-16T00:02:54Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2610_22760.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI","cs.SE"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 决定暴露哪些程序实体，比如新增文件、函数、类、属性、编辑位置；projection 决定对这些实体暴露哪些属性，比如名字、签名、位置、语义描述、实现指导。现有 benchmark 往往把两者混在一起，因此不同 hint scheme 的效果很难归因。\n\n在这个框架下，作者提出两套策略。第一是 DefUse selection。它不试图把参考实现里所有新增组件都告诉模型，而是优先选择那些位于“实现与测试交互边界”的标识符，也就是测试真正会调用、引用、检查的接口实体。这个思路比“暴露所有新增组件”更克制，因为 benchmark 真正需要消除的是测试接口层面的猜测，而不是把内部实现结构也一并公开。\n\n第二是 Declaration projection。对于被选中的实体，只暴露 declaration 级别的信息，例如名称、类型、签名、所在文件或位置等接口属性，但避免给出语义解释、行为描述、实现建议等更接近参考解设计意图的内容。这样做的目标是只解决 hidden interface mismatch，不替模型做设计。\n\n论文还把已有 benchmark 的 hint 方案放进这个二维坐标系里比较，强调 selection 和 projection 必须分开做 controlled comparison。除此之外，作者引入了一个 LLM-based judge 来评估 hint 的三个属性：这些信息是否是完成任务所必需、是否泄露了参考解中的实现选择、是否对模型行为形成了额外指导。这个 judge 不是替代执行评测，而是补充 solve rate 无法揭示的信息泄露程度。","experiments":"实验覆盖五个 repository-level coding benchmark，横跨 Python 和 Java，并在三种语言模型上比较不同 hint policy。全文的重点不是追求单一最高分，而是看不同 selection/projection 组合如何改变“解题率”和“信息泄露”之间的平衡。\n\n主要结论有几条。第一，性能提升经常伴随更高程度的 solution disclosure。也就是说，一些 hint scheme 之所以让模型分数更高，不一定是因为它们更好地消除了 under-specification，也可能是因为它们把原本应由模型完成的设计决策提前告诉了模型。第二，把 selection 和 projection 分开后，可以看到两者对结果的影响并不等价：暴露哪些实体，与暴露这些实体到什么粒度，都会显著改变 benchmark 难度和测量对象。第三，DefUse + Declaration 这一组合在作者的分析里更接近一个折中点：它能减少因隐藏接口造成的无谓失败，同时比更激进的 hint 方案少泄露实现语义和行为指导。\n\n论文还做了 hint attribute ablation，分析名称、签名、位置、语义描述等不同属性各自带来的影响；并在 SWE-bench Pro 上用 LLM judge 进一步检查哪些属性属于必要接口信息，哪些已经开始接近 spoiler。给出的核心洞察不是某个绝对数字，而是 benchmark 设计不能只看 solve rate 排名，必须同时看 disclosure profile。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，先把 guesswork 与 spoilers 的问题设定吃透。然后看方法部分里 selection / projection evidence 要求同时保留两个可能指代对象对应的并行证据链；conditional evidence 要求保留结论及其限定条件，防止压缩后把带条件陈述改写成无条件事实；imbalanced evidence 则要求在多数证据之外保留少数观点，测试压缩器是否会被证据量主导而忽略 minority perspective。第二，它把每个查询所需证据从原文中抽取出来，并分解成最小、自包含的 propositions。评测时不是看语义大意是否接近，而是逐条判断 proposition 是否被压缩文本明确陈述或可无歧义推出。第三，它提出 All Proposition Recall（All-Rec）：只有当一个样本所需的全部 propositions 都被保留时才记为成功。这比平均 proposition recall 更严格，因为真实推理常常被最短板决定。另一个指标 EPR 用 All-Rec 除以平均推理 TFLOPs，衡量单位计算换来多少证据保留。这个设计把“效果”和“代价”放到同一坐标系里，适合比较不同规模、不同压缩范式。","experiments":"基准共 4,102 个样本，覆盖三类证据结构。作者评测了 17 个压缩器配置，包括专用压缩模型和通用 LLM。结果很直接：专用压缩器整体 All-Rec 都低于 10%；10B 以下通用模型也低于 30%。较强模型虽有提升，但仍远未可靠。Gemma-4-31B-it 的 overall All-Rec 为 66.8%，Claude-Haiku-4.5 为 61.6%。这发生在一个并不极端的设定下：原始上下文平均只有 3.1K tokens，而被测模型上下文窗口在 32K 到 400K 之间，说明问题不是“放不下”，而是“压缩时没保住”。不同证据结构上的排名差异也很大，例如 主要帮助已经较强的模型，能力差距会被拉大而不是缩小；相关证据之间距离越远，联合保留概率越低；越靠前出现的证据越容易被保留。这些现象说明压缩器更像是在做启发式显著性筛选，而不是稳定地建模“哪些证据必须一起保留”。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解作者为什么反对用 QA accuracy 代理 faithfulness。然后重点看 是否会把已有产物当成事实，还是会回到原始需求重新核对。这件事和真实部署很相关，因为多轮会话、多人协作、多 agent pipeline 都天然会产生状态继承。对基座研究员来说，启发在两点。第一，当前 agent 能力评测过度依赖 clean-start，容易高估模型在真实软件流程中的可用性。第二，论文识别出的 acceptance bias start 上直接对比，差值就是 starting-state robustness 的损失。第三，论文给出 residualization pipeline，用于从 DeepSWE 和 Terminal-Bench 的原任务中系统地收集、验证、筛选这些残留状态，并且 predecessor 覆盖了 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM 三个模型家族，避免 benchmark 未涉及的文件，这进一步说明它把已有实现当成可信锚点。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、benchmark 构造细节和失败分析认真看完。先看 Introduction，作者对问题定义得很清楚，尤其是 clean start 与 residual start 的区别，以及为什么这不是简单的 harder benchmark。然后看 SWE-Residual 能力可能并不相同。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a capability that standard coding-agent benchmarks largely miss: can an agent successfully continue a task when the starting state already contains prior work that looks complete but is still wrong or incomplete? Existing SWE-style benchmarks mostly use clean starts, so they measure from-scratch problem solving. They do not measure whether an agent can inherit a partially solved repository or machine state, infer what remains broken without prior context, and finish the task. The paper names this capability Starting-State Robustness and shows that strong clean-start performance does not imply strong robustness under inherited states.","importance":"This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it exposes a mismatch between benchmarked capability and deployed behavior. ConCI turns CI assessment from independent item classification into controlled counterfactual consistency testing, which better separates “refusal bias” from genuine conditional norm understanding. For each anchor information flow (a vignette parameterized by CI roles/actors, data type, and transmission principle/purpose), the dataset perturbs exactly one CI parameter (notably recipient or purpose) while holding all others fixed. Two counterfactuals are generated per anchor: (1) a label-flipped variant where appropriateness should change, and (2) a label-held variant where appropriateness should remain the same. Evaluation uses a joint triplet metric: credit is given only if all three judgments are correct, directly testing sensitivity to the controlled change. The released set is close to label-balanced, reducing the payoff of blanket refusal. Each flow is validated by seven independent human annotators, and per-flow annotations are released for error analysis.","experiments":"Across seven LLMs, the paper compares standard anchor-only item accuracy (mirroring prior benchmarks) against ConCI’s triplet-level joint scoring. Even the strongest model fails on roughly one-fifth of triplets. Errors are asymmetric: models are near-ceiling on inappropriate flows but substantially worse on appropriate flows; larger models reduce but do not eliminate this gap. Adding explicit reasoning yields only modest gains, suggesting the bottleneck is conditional norm boundary modeling rather than missing step-by-step reasoning. It studies whether each LLM call site in agentic systems has a well-defined and actually enforced software contract. The central question is simple but important: once a program replaces deterministic logic with an LLM call, what guarantees correctness, safety, and policy compliance? In ordinary software, behavior is fixed by code and constrained by types, assertions, tests, and verification. For LLM calls, outputs are stochastic, input-steerable, and not exhaustively testable. So the guarantee must move into the surrounding program: preconditions before the call, constraints inside the prompt, and postconditions after the reply. The paper formalizes this as a call-site contract and asks, at scale, what these contracts should be, what is actually implemented, where the gaps are, and whether those gaps become real exploits at runtime.","importance":"This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for anyone thinking about the interface between model training and deployment. Its main lesson is that many agent failures are not just model failures. They come from systems outsourcing software guarantees to prompts or to the model’s goodwill. That has two implications for foundation-model work. First, stronger models do not replace program-level enforcement when outputs drive tools, control flow, or execution. Second, the structure of these contracts suggests where training objectives and model interfaces should improve: structured outputs, schema adherence, refusal boundaries, tool-call validation, policy-aware decoding, and verifier placement. subbands。这样低频结构和高频细节、不同方向分量被拆开，原来混杂的预测任务变成多个统计性质更清晰的子任务。第二部分是面向数值符号的 LLM 接口。作者没有把 wavelet coefficient 当普通离散 token 粗暴处理，而是设计了 coding-oriented numerical adaptation：对每个局部上下文中的系数值建立紧凑 local symbol space，把真实数值映射到局部 ID；同时引入 trainable value embedding，并用专门的 value prediction head 只在合法取值范围内做预测。这样做的原因很明确：预训练 LLM 擅长离散 token，但波域系数是数值型、范围随子带和上下文变化，若直接共享全局词表会造成词表稀疏、无效类别过多、数值邻近关系利用不足。第三部分是 prompt-based adaptive entropy coding。不同 subband 仍有明显分布差异，若每个子带单独训练模型，参数和部署成本都高。作者因此用任务提示把 subband identity、解码上下文等条件注入同一个共享 backbone，让一个 3B LLM 在不同子带间切换。整体上，概率分解仍遵循因果编码顺序，并最终接 arithmetic coding 完成无损压缩。方法上的关键取舍是：前端用固定可逆变换保证编码正确性和工程稳定性，学习部分集中在概率建模接口与条件化适配，而不是端到端学习整套 codec。","experiments":"主结果上，WaveLLM 在 Kodak、CLIC.pro、DIV2K 上分别达到 2.51、2.24、2.27 bpsp。论文强调它只用 3B backbone，却超过了近期 8B 级 LLM-based compressors，并且和强 learned lossless codecs 保持竞争力。对这类工作，bpsp 越低越好，因此这个结果说明改表示后，同等甚至更小模型容量可以得到更好的熵估计。消融的关键信息主要应看三类：一是域选择，像素域/残差域/波域的比较，用来支撑“输入可预测性”这个主张；二是数值接口设计，验证 local ID 映射、value embedding、dedicated value head 是否都必要；三是共享模型的 prompt 适配，相比每子带独立模型或不加 prompt 的共享模型，是否在压缩率和参数效率之间取得更好平衡。摘要里没有给出更细的消融数字，但从全文叙述看，作者不是靠单一大模型堆出来的提升，而是靠表示分解和接口设计共同带来的收益。","reading_guide":"泛读时先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure Joint freezes a pair of jointly pretrained towers and trains a fusion head. Decoupled freezes independently pretrained unimodal encoders and trains only the downstream fusion module. Agent uses the same unimodal encoders as Decoupled, adds supervised unimodal readouts, and gives a frozen LLM task instructions, examples, available text, and readout outputs. For the fusion systems, the paper searches over eight standard fusion heads and selects checkpoints or hyperparameters using a fixed development split. It also includes component controls such as LLM-only and unimodal probes. pretrain、agentic RL、工具使用训练和长期在线改进。贡献的量级主要在训练范式：它把经验学习从“整条轨迹重写”或“完全跟随学生轨迹”改成“只在错误开始的局部片段插入 teacher 行为”。这个选择很关键，因为长轨迹学习的主要困难常常不是缺少反馈，而是反馈落在了不合适的状态分布上。","technical_approach":"LoCD 包含两步。第一步是 localized attribution：给定一次 interaction experience，即任务、学生生成的轨迹和环境或用户反馈，方法先定位需要修正的 critical span。这个 span 对应学生行为开始偏离的局部片段，并把相关 privileged context 归因到这个片段。第二步是 localized distillation：从学生自己的前缀出发，让拥有 privileged context 的 teacher 只重新生成这个短片段，然后用该片段训练没有 privileged context 的 student。这样做和 off-policy distillation 的区别是，LoCD 不让 teacher 接管整条轨迹，训练前缀仍然来自学生，因此状态分布更接近推理时。它和 on-policy distillation 的区别是，LoCD 不要求所有监督都落在学生已经生成的 token 上，而是在关键位置引入 teacher 生成的局部行为，因此可以直接教会学生当前分布之外的动作或推理步骤。论文还通过 controlled knowledge-injection 实验解释 on-policy 的瓶颈：答案越长，学习越呈现逐步推进的模式，因为后半段监督只有在学生先生成接近目标的前缀时才变得有效。这说明完全 on-policy 的 token-level 蒸馏会受 sequential learning bottleneck 限制。","experiments":"实验覆盖数学推理、代码生成、交互式决策和软件工程任务。相对最强基线，LoCD 在数学推理上提升 5.65%，代码生成提升 2.65%，WebShop 提升 5.60%，ALFWorld 提升 i","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-14T19:15:36Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_20828.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI","cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是 reasoning distillation 里的数据生成瓶颈。学生模型要学会推理，通常需要带有正确答案的高质量 chain-of-thought 数据。最常见做法是让教师从问题出发生成 forward CoT，再用 rejection sampling 保留答对的样本；问题是难题上采样成本很高。另一条路是给教师问题和答案，让它生成 reverse CoT，这样便宜很多，但会产生 post-hoc rationalization：推理过程只是对已知答案的事后解释，而不是从问题出发的可学习推导。论文的核心问题是，能否把便宜的 reverse CoT 转换成更接近 verified forward CoT 分布的数据，从而在较低教师成本下得到更适合蒸馏的推理轨迹。","importance":"它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / reasoning data construction，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因很简单：高质量推理数据越来越像一种稀缺训练信号，而不是随手可得的副产物。CoTranslator 给出的启发是，数据生成不一定非要直接从目标分布昂贵采样，也可以先从便宜但有偏的分布采样，再学习一个分布校正器。这个思路对合成推理数据、RL 前的数据准备、甚至某些 curriculum 设计都有参考价值。它的贡献量级主要体现在成本-效果折中：在明显更低的 teacher compute 下，保留了大部分 rejection sampling 的收益，并且比直接用 reverse CoT 或语义抑制类方法更稳。","technical_approach":"方法的关键是把 reverse CoT 到 verified forward CoT 的差异显式建模成一个 translation 问题，而不是继续在 prompt 上做约束。\n\n设问题为 q，正确答案为 a。Forward CoT 分布是教师仅看 q 生成推理；rejection sampling 从中筛出最终答案等于 a 的样本。Reverse CoT 分布则是教师在输入里同时看到 (q, a) 后生成推理。作者认为学生真正需要学习的是 rejection-sampled forward CoT 的分布，而不是 reverse CoT 的分布。\n\n于是他们先构造一个小规模配对集。对同一个问题，采一个 reverse CoT 响应 x，再从 forward CoT 多次采样，保留第一个答对的响应 z，形成 (x, z) 配对。然后训练一个 translator G_phi，用 teacher forcing 从 x 预测 z。一个重要设计是：translator 只看 reverse CoT 文本 x，不额外输入问题 q 或答案 a。这样做有两个目的。第一，和文中的分布推导保持一致，目标是学习从 source response 到 target response 的映射。第二，避免模型直接走 question-answer bypass，继续利用显式答案信息投机。\n\n训练好 translator 后，大规模数据构造时每个问题只需一次 reverse teacher call 得到 x，再一次 translator call 得到 z_hat，最后用 (q, z_hat) 训练学生。相比 rejection sampling 可能需要多次 forward teacher call 才拿到一个可用样本，这个流程把高成本部分压缩成一次便宜采样加一次较小模型翻译。\n\n与已有 semantic suppression 或结构约束方法相比，区别在于它不试图让 reverse CoT 自己“少泄露答案”，而是直接学习一个目标分布映射器。论文附录还给了 distribution recovery 相关分析，说明在一定条件下 translator 输出分布可以逼近 rejection-sampled forward 分布。","experiments":"实验覆盖六个学生模型和六个数学 benchmark，并做了三个迁移设置：迁移到新数学数据集、换教师模型、迁移到 STEM 题目。摘要和正文给出的关键数字有几项。\n\n第一，效果对比。对 Qwen3-4B-Base 这类 4B 学生，CoTranslator 相比 semantic suppression 平均准确率最高提升 5.82 个百分点。说明仅仅抑制答案泄露不够，显式分布翻译更有效。\n\n第二，成本-性能折中。两个 4B 学生在仅用 rejection sampling 估算算力的 35.9% 时，保留了其平均准确率的 95.0%。这是全文最核心的结果，因为它直接回答了“为什么不用 RS 直接生成”的问题：RS 更干净，但太贵；CoTranslator 用较小配对集训练 translator 后，可以在大规模生成阶段显著降本。\n\n第三，泛化。translator 不重训即可迁移到新数学数据集、不同教师和 STEM 领域。4B 和 8B 学生在 STEM 上平均分别提升 4.88 和 and","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-15T10:21:41Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_21640.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.DC"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 LLM RL post-training 里的一个老问题，但切得更深：rollout 生成远比策略更新贵，而且多轮 agent 轨迹长度、工具调用时延、样本难度都高度不均，导致同步训练里 trainer 经常等数据，异步训练里又会因为 stale policy 过大而掉质量。已有异步系统主要是在“生成和训练并行”这一层做文章，仍然保留了批次级的数据依赖，trainer 还是会因为 fresh rollout 不够而停顿。ReFlow 要解决的是：能不能在不明显破坏 RL 稳定性的前提下，把 rollout 需求进一步降下来，把训练和生成真正解耦，并且让资源分配随 workload 动态变化。","importance":"对预训练研究员来说，这不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它和 pretrain↔posttrain 接口很相关。原因有两点。第一，当前大模型能力提升越来越依赖 RL 阶段，尤其是 reasoning 和 agentic setting；如果 RL 的单位算力产出太低，前面预训练得到的 base model 很难被充分榨干。第二，这篇工作的核心启发不是单纯系统工程，而是 system–algorithm co-design：它把 experience replay 从传统 RL 里重新带回 LLM post-training，并把“少做昂贵 trainer 严格绑在“等一批新 rollout 再更新”这个节奏上，而是维护一个可复用的近期经验池，让 trainer 可以持续从 replay buffer 中取样训练，同时 rollout workers 异步补充新轨迹。这样做的关键不是简单把 off-policy RL 套进来，而是控制 policy mismatch，避免旧样本把训练带偏。\n\n从论文给出的动机看，作者的设计有三层。第一层是执行层完全解耦：rollout 和 training 在资源上分离，trainer 不再受 batch-ready fresh data 的硬约束，减少长尾生成造成的 GPU bubble。第二层是算法层引入近期经验重放，并配合 staleness-aware 的样本使用策略与修正机制，让 replay 样本主要来自“足够近”的行为策略，从而在效率和稳定性之间取平衡。文中还给出理论分析，说明适度 replay 能降低梯度方差，这一点很重要，因为 LLM RL 的 reward 噪声和序列长度方差都很大，方差下降直接关系到 update 的可用性。第三层是运行时自适应：由于 rollout/training 的相对瓶颈会随训练阶段、任务类型、模型大小、硬件平台变化，ReFlow This differs from direct RL because the pretrained generator is frozen, and differs from test-time noise optimization because the search is amortized during training. Adversarial Training）的改造。训练样本不是普通 instruction-response，而是为每个带有“说谎压力”的 prompt x 构造一对目标 continuation：y+ 是与模型已有知识或上下文一致的诚实回答，y- 是顺从压力、陈述相反命题的 dishonest 回答。训练目标同时做两件事：把模型朝 y+ 拉近，把模型从 y- 推远。\n\n难点在于，诚实训练不像安全拒答那样可以用统一的 toward target。拒答任务里，几乎所有 harmful prompt 都可以朝一个通用 refusal 模板收缩；但 honesty 的 truth/lie 都依赖具体命题和上下文，所以每个样本都要单独构造正负目标。这也是为什么作者没有直接用普通 SFT：SFT 只能在见过的 prompt 模式上拟合目标分布，面对新的施压方式、博弈环境或 concealment setting，泛化往往不够。\n\nCATCH 的关键是把“最坏情况下会诱发 y- 的 prompt 扰动”放到 embedding 空间里近似搜索。具体做法是：对输入 token embedding 加有界扰动 δ，在一个约束集合内用 K 步 projected signed gradient ascent 最大化 log pθ(y-|x+δ)，得到局部最坏扰动；然后在外层优化中，让模型在这些 adversarially perturbed prompts 上降低 y- 的概率、提高 y+ 的概率。这样训练出来的不是对固定 wording 的诚实，而是对一小片 prompt 邻域的诚实鲁棒性。\n\n论文还强调 capability preservation。作者不是只拿 honesty 数据做训练，而是混入 utility dataset，防止模型因为强行压制某类 continuation 而整体退化。更有意思的是，他们研究了 utility dataset 的选择，发现不同 utility 数据对能力保持影响很大，并提出了一个更合适的选择策略。和 honesty steering 相比，CATCH 的优点是训练后行为更稳定，不依赖推理时额外干预；和大规模 honesty SFT Recovery）针对的是“没有安全梯度”这个问题。做法分两层。第一层是 advantage-guided trajectory filtering：不是把一个 prompt 下所有 rollout 一视同仁地做组内归一化，而是优先保留那些仍然带有相对信息的轨迹子集，让组内 reward variance 不至于完全消失。第二层是在信号彻底塌陷时引入 safe reference supervision，用安全参考响应提供额外监督，避免 all-unsafe 组上完全无梯度。也就是说，它不是只靠 GRPO 的相对奖励，而是在相对信号失效区域补上一条外部锚点。SUDA（Safety-Utility Decoupled Alignment）处理的是安全税。作者区分 harmful prompts 和 benign prompts：对 harmful prompt 强化拒答或安全完成；对 benign prompt 则避免过强安全约束伤害有用性。具体上使用 category-aware rewards，并把 KL anchoring 主要施加在 benign prompts 上，而不是对所有样本统一收紧。这样做的动机很明确：如果 harmful 和 benign 都被同一套保守约束驱动，模型容易学成普遍拒答；把两类样本解耦后，安全优化和能力保持的目标冲突会小一些。全文的理论部分还分析了为什么 entropy bonus 在 relative advantage 消失时会放大 unsafe diversification，这一点是方法设计的重要依据。","experiments":"实验覆盖四个模型变体，包括 Qwen3 和 是否仍然存在。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a specific failure mode of GRPO-based safety alignment for large reasoning models. GRPO depends on within-group reward differences to produce policy gradients. In safety alignment, however, rollouts from the same prompt often become behaviorally homogeneous: many sampled responses are all unsafe, or all lie on the same side of the safety boundary. Once the reward variance inside a group collapses, the normalized advantages vanish and GRPO stops receiving meaningful safety-directed updates. The authors identify two concrete consequences. The first is advantage collapse, where all-unsafe groups yield near-zero learning signal. The second is unsafe diversification, where entropy regularization keeps encouraging exploration after the relative signal disappears, causing the model to spread probability mass over more diverse unsafe responses rather than becoming safer.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The paper’s main contribution is diagnostic and mechanistic rather than paradigm-shifting: it explains why a widely used RL recipe can fail in safety alignment, and it proposes a practical fix. The broader lesson extends beyond safety. explanation. In principle, equal-reward responses should preserve their relative probability ratios under the KL-regularized optimum. In practice, GRPO relies on a small number of on-policy rollouts. Once a correct reasoning mode is under-sampled, it contributes little to the policy update, its probability can decline further, and recovery becomes unlikely. This is relevant to post-training design because the base model’s diverse correct reasoning behaviors should be treated as a resource to preserve, not just as noise to be replaced by a narrower high-reward style.","technical_approach":"The method, Targeted Adaptive Replay (TAR), reuses correct and diverse trajectories that are already present in the base policy. During RLVR, TAR does not continuously imitate this bank. Instead, it uses a gated replay mechanism: a stored trajectory becomes an auxiliary training signal only when it has become less likely under the current policy than under the base policy. The update is further concentrated on the most suppressed tokens. This makes the replay signal corrective and targeted. be repaired before running RL again? The main claim is that failures are localized. A small set of diagnostic n-grams in RL rollouts strongly predicts incorrect outcomes. These n-grams are not treated as causal triggers; they are observable markers that the rollout has entered a region from which the policy rarely recovers.","importance":"The useful contribution for pretraining research is the feedback loop from RL failures to continued-pretraining data selection. This work instead mines the model’s own failed RL rollouts, retrieves matching pretraining text, and runs a small targeted continued-pretraining stage before repeating RL. First, the authors run RLVR with GRPO and collect rollouts. They identify n-grams whose presence strongly predicts failure. For weaker models on elementary math, these are often reflection or self-correction phrases such as “let’s recheck”; for stronger models on broader reasoning suites, they can be more operation-specific, such as matrix inversion or reduced row echelon form. Second, they argue that these states are hard for on-policy RL to repair, because learning depends on successful continuations sampled from the current policy, and such continuations are rare after the failure-marked states. Another useful result is transfer: a corpus mined from OLMo2-1B failures improves Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B by up to 2.4 points. attention mass、step entropy、token log-prob 这类行为信号给步骤打分；问题在于，这些分数描述的是“这一步看起来像不像多余”，而不是“答案是否真的依赖这一步”。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何给单个推理步骤定义更接近因果贡献的 credit，并把这种 credit 用到 RL 训练里，在缩短 CoT 学习都很关键。第二，它说明“短答案”不能靠统一压缩，必须区分必要计算和冗余计算；这和预训练里对 token 价值、训练信号密度、latent reasoning 的讨论是连着的。第三，它提出的 parameter-level intervention 比文本删除更接近模型内部依赖结构，这个思路以后可以迁移到 pretraining data attribution、reasoning token 时，如果抑制该步对应的潜在计算，模型对最终答案的置信度会变化多少。关键不是直接删文本，因为删掉一步后模型会重新生成后续内容，补偿效应会掩盖真实依赖。作者改用参数级干预：对目标步骤 s_n 在其前缀 h_n 条件下做 preference-based unlearning，具体用 NPO+KL，把“生成这一步”的倾向压低，同时用 retain set 上的 KL 约束避免模型整体漂移。然后固定前缀和基模型候选答案，不重新生成后续推理，只测答案置信度变化幅度，把它作为 ISC。这样得到的 credit 更接近“这一步的内部计算是否支撑了答案预测”。\n\n第二层是 IGPO。因为逐步做干预代价高，作者先离线用 ISC 给步骤打标签，再训练一个在线 step-level predictor 预测 credit。RL 阶段，IGPO 不直接改 reward，而是改 stepwise advantage。对正确轨迹里的低 ISC 步骤，缩小正 advantage，减少模型继续强化这些冗余步骤；对高 ISC 步骤，则在出现负 advantage 时做保护，避免重要推理被错误压制。这个设计和统一长度惩罚不同：它不是鼓励“整体更短”，而是鼓励“删掉不影响答案的部分，保留真正承载推理的部分”。从机制上看，它把 credit assignment 从 trajectory level 下沉到 step level，又避免了逐 token 奖励过噪的问题。\n\n和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，attention/entropy 类方法是 observational signal，ISC 是 intervention-based signal。其二，早停类方法只找停止点，不能处理保留前缀内部的冗余；ISC/IGPO 直接给前缀内部步骤打分。其三，长度奖励或 concise RL 往往把“短”和“好”绑定，IGPO 则显式允许长但关键的步骤保留下来。","experiments":"论文在两个代表性 LLM、九个 benchmark 上评估。摘要里给出的主结果是：IGPO 相比 base model，平均响应长度最多下降 62.0%，同时 macro-average accuracy 最多提升 8.4 个百分点；在两个模型尺度上，macro-average accuracy 和 efficiency score 都是对比方法里最优。这里的结论重点不是单纯“更短”，而是“更短且更准”，说明 credit 估计确实在区分必要与冗余步骤。\n\nISC 本身还做了 post-hoc CoT pruning 实验。作者把 ISC、attention mass、step entropy 等分数用于删步骤，比较 accuracy–pruning frontier。结果显示 ISC 在高删除率区域更稳，说明当需要激进压缩推理时，干预式 credit 比行为统计量更能识别真正可删的步骤。这一点很关键，因为很多启发式分数在轻度剪枝时看起来有效，但一旦删得多就会误伤关键步骤。\n\n分析部分还指出，IGPO 生成的 CoT 在计算和逻辑演绎上更可靠，冗余复述和无效延伸更少。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从作者的实验设计看，值得注意的消融应包括：1）不用 ISC、只做长度控制的 RL；2）用 attention/entropy 替代 ISC 做 advantage rescaling；3）只做 pruning 不做 online predictor；4）是否对高 ISC 步骤做 negative-advantage shielding。真正要看的不是平均长度，而是 accuracy-length Pareto 前沿是否整体外移，以及高难题上是否保住了长推理所需的关键步骤。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓住两个问题：为什么文本级删步不够，为什么统一长度惩罚会伤精度。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解作者要证明的是“step However, in our dataset","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_24229.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI","cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"LIFT 解决的是 RLVR 训练前的 prompt 选择成本问题。现有 training-free 方法 SHIFT 需要对每个候选 prompt 生成完整 greedy rollout，再用轨迹信号估计 prompt 价值。但在数学推理数据上，完整 rollout 经常因为重复或不终止而浪费大量 token。LIFT 试图只用一段早期 reasoning prefix 来完成选择。","importance":"这项工作对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 数据效率有参考价值。RLVR 的瓶颈之一是 rollout 成本，尤其是在大候选池上做数据筛选时。LIFT 的启发是：prompt 是否有训练价值，可能在生成早期已经能从模型条件分布的变化中看出来，不一定需要完整答案、奖励标签或一轮预训练式微调信号。这个思想也可迁移到更一般的数据选择问题：用模型自身的条件概率变化估计样本信息量，而不是依赖人工标签或训练中梯度。","technical_approach":"方法名为 LIFT，核心打分函数是 Partial Rollout Context Lift，简称 PRCL。对每个 prompt x，先用初始策略在完整 chat template 下 greedy 生成一条确定性 rollout y(x)，但只取前 K 个 token。然后构造一个 null context，即保留 system prompt 和模板，但移除 user prompt。对同一段生成前缀 y，在有问题和无问题两个上下文下做 teacher forcing，计算每个 token 的 log probability ratio，并累加得到 PRCL。这个分数衡量的是：用户问题使模型自己生成的 reasoning prefix 变得多大程度上更可预测。K 不是手工固定到完整长度，而是在候选池中随机抽取 γ 比例样本，计算到 Kmax，再找出累计分数达到 α 比例的最短前缀长度。最后用这个 K 对候选池打分，选 top-B prompt 进入后续 RLVR。相对 SHIFT，LIFT 不依赖完整轨迹的 hidden-state shift，而是用部分轨迹的条件似然提升；相对 training-dependent 选择方法，它不需要奖励、答案标签或先跑一段 RL。","experiments":"实验使用 Math-500 和 LIMR 等推理数据。作者观察到 26%–32% 的 greedy trajectory 在生成预算内无法正常终止，多数表现为固定 n-gram 重复。短前缀能保留完整轨迹选择信号的 90% 以上，同时显著减少生成 token。PRCL 选择出的子集在不同模型和选择预算下，训练后性能接近全量池训练，也能与完整轨迹选择方法竞争；选择成本降低 3.7–9.1 倍。作者还把 partial-rollout 观察用于改造 SHIFT：在检测到 n-gram 重复开始时提前停止 decoding，可在四个设置中降低 1.5–2.0 倍选择成本，且下游准确率没有下降。","reading_guide":"建议泛读，预计 20–25 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 PRCL 的定义、null context 的构造、teacher forcing 的打分方式，以及用 γ、α、Kmax 自适应选择前缀长度的算法。实验部分优先看三类结果：完整 rollout 的非终止和重复分析；prefix length 与选择信号保留率的关系；PRCL、SHIFT、random、full-pool training 的成本-性能对比。若只关心能否复用，最值得检查的是 PRCL 对模型、数据集、chat template 和 decoding 策略的敏感性。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"LIFT targets the cost of prompt selection before RLVR training. Validation，确保公式实现和变量关系没有写错；之后对变量采样或设定具体数值，生成满足适用条件的实例，并通过 Instance Execution 得到参考答案 y*。这个顺序很重要：先执行出答案，再去写题面。这样自然语言生成只是“表达一个已经成立的物理实例”，而不是让模型在开放空间里同时发明场景、关系和答案。相比直接 prompting LLM 生成题目+解答，这种做法把错误空间压缩了很多。\n\n第三段是 teacher distillation。作者仍然使用 teacher model 生成 reasoning trace，但不直接信任 teacher 的过程或结论，而是用执行得到的参考答案做 Answer Verification，只保留最终答案与 y* 一致的轨迹 τ。也就是说，teacher 的角色从“真值来源”降级为“语言化解释器”。这和很多合成 CoT 数据工作不同：后者常常把 teacher 输出整体当监督，容易把幻觉和错误推理一并蒸馏进去。\n\n从设计取舍看，TIRE 的重点不是追求形式化证明级别的完整 correctness，而是建立一个更现实的中间层：结构化知识 + 可执行验证 + 语言表达分离。它没有完全解决物理场景语义真实性的问题，例如题面措辞是否总是自然、是否覆盖复杂多步建模，但它显著提高了数值监督的可信度和题目构造的可控性。","experiments":"数据方面，作者构建了 TIRE-19k，共 19,144 个样本，覆盖 9 个物理子领域，底层依托 3,051 条公式记录。每个样本都包含自然语言问题、执行得到的参考答案，以及通过答案校验筛出的 teacher reasoning trace。\n\n实验设置上，论文在 3 个 backbone、4 个 benchmark 上比较 TIRE-19k 与已有物理推理数据，在相同训练数据量条件下，TIRE 在 domain 内表现和 out-of-domain 泛化上都更好。摘要和正文给出的主结论是：同等数据预算下，TIRE-19k 优于现有数据构造路线，说明提升主要来自数据质量与监督可靠性，而不只是样本数增加。\n\n更有信息量的是消融。作者分别验证了几个关键部件：\n1. top-down formula instantiation 相比直接文本生成更有效，说明“先公式实例、后语言表达”的顺序是有用的；\n2. reliable execution 带来的 reference answer 是关键，没有执行锚点时，teacher trace 的噪声会明显上升；\n3. teacher comparison 显示该框架对不同 teacher 都成立，说明收益不是绑定某一个强 teacher；\n4. 在 SFT 之后继续做 GRPO 还能进一步提升，说明这类 execution-grounded 数据不仅适合监督学习，也能为基于结果奖励的后训练提供较干净的起点。\n\n从可解释性上看，这篇实验最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 数字，而是它证明了一个数据构造原则：当答案可由独立程序给出时，teacher 只负责生成可读推理，而不负责定义真值，训练信号会稳很多。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓方法主线，再看数据构造细节，预计 20–30 非常接近单位阵，真正被去掉的方向很少，所以“靠投影保护知识”这件事在默认配置里并不成立。第二，如果强行加大投影强度，确实能更强地保护旧知识，但会明显损害 edit efficacy 和 locality，说明硬子空间约束的代价很高。\n\n基于这个观察，作者把 preservation 重新表述成 regularization 问题：关键不是把更新投到某个粗糙子空间，而是按参数对一般行为的敏感性，做细粒度约束。于是提出 FisherEdit。它用对角 Fisher 估计每个参数的重要性，把更新惩罚从统一的 L2 或子空间约束，改成 element-wise、importance-aware 的加权惩罚。直观上，Fisher 大的参数更“脆弱”，改动它们更容易影响模型原有分布，因此惩罚更强；Fisher 小的参数更可塑，允许承担更多新事实写入。\n\n从优化形式看，FisherEdit 不是在 activation space 里做投影，而是在 parameter space 里解一个带 Fisher 加权二次正则的编辑目标。作者还给出 row-wise closed-form solver，使它在实现上保持接近 ROME/MEMIT/AlphaEdit mechanistic analysis rather than training recipes. Activation-based decompositions have explained many intermediate representations, but their surrogate functions do not match the actual parameters and nonlinearities that implement the model. That mismatch makes parameter editing and out-of-distribution mechanism analysis difficult. A faithful parameter-level decomposition could help study modularity, superposition, parameter reuse, and the stability of learned algorithms during and after pretraining.","technical_approach":"The method is adVersarial Parameter Decomposition, or VPD. It builds on Stochastic Parameter Decomposition by representing model weights as a sum of parameter components and encouraging sparse component usage per datapoint. Components that are unnecessary for a datapoint should be removable without increasing output reconstruction error. The main change is a stronger ablatability criterion: reconstruction must hold not only under stochastic ablations but also under adversarially selected ablations. This is meant to prevent decompositions that look sparse and faithful under easy perturbations but fail under harder component-removal patterns. Compared with activation-based transcoders or mixtures of linear transforms, VPD decomposes the actual parameters used by the model, which makes the account closer to the implemented computation and less tied to a particular architectural block.","experiments":"The paper applies VPD to a full small language model with 67M parameters and four layers, trained on The Pile. The paper also emphasizes output reconstruction under adversarial ablations as a key faithfulness metric relative to earlier SPD-style methods. sup","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-15T04:37:53Z","category_id":"mechanism","cover_url":"/covers/2610_21240.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 试图把“单次观察”提升为“跨变体可重复的支持集”，这对 interpretability、对齐审计、prompt robustness 分析都更有用。对基座研究员来说，价值在于方法论：如果想用 SAE 去研究 tokenizer 变化、数据风格变化、指令模板变化如何影响内部表示，先要有一个能区分偶然扰动和稳定重分布的统计对象。论文还进一步把表示变化和 readout 贡献拆开，提醒人不要把 feature 变化直接等同于行为原因。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 Redistribution Sensitivity Score，简称 RSS。它不是简单找变化最大的 feature，而是同时要求三个条件：变化幅度大、在多个变体上反复出现、并且方向一致。具体做法是：对某个 clean prompt 及其一组 transformed variants，在目标位置计算每个 SAE feature 的激活变化。先用平均绝对变化 h_f 形成候选池，避免正负抵消；再统计每个 feature 在多少个观测上超过阈值 τ，以及这些响应是否大多同向，得到 recurrence r_f 和 consistency c_f。只有满足 r_f≥ρ、c_f≥κ 的 feature 才有资格进入支持集，最后从中取变化幅度最大的前 K 个，形成 responsive support S。MeanRSS 则用来汇总这个支持集的平均响应强度。\n\n这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，选择和评估分离。支持集和方向是在 selector variants 上固定出来的，然后在 disjoint held-out variants 上直接评估，不重新挑 feature。这避免了“看过测试集再讲故事”。第二，RSS 的定义不使用 readout 权重，因此它先回答“哪些表示变化是稳定的”，再单独分析“这些变化是否影响某个下游线性 readout”。\n\n在 readout 分析部分，作者对固定线性 probe 做精确分解：某个 recurrent feature change 对 logit 的贡献，取决于激活变化大小、对应 readout weight、方向是否对齐，以及 clean prompt 原本离决策阈值还有多远。这样就把三件事拆开了：表示重分布、readout 分数变化、最终 threshold crossing。这个拆分很重要，因为一个 feature 可以稳定变化，但若 readout 权重很小或多个 feature 贡献互相抵消，就未必导致行为失败。\n\n论文还给出有限样本下的方向稳定性保证。比如 n=5、ρ=κ=0.8 时，入选 feature 至少有 4 次同向响应、至多 1 次反向，因此删掉一次观测也不至于翻转方向。这种约束让“稳定重分布”这个对象更像一个可复验的 support，而不是一次性排序结果。","experiments":"实验覆盖 27 个预训练 SAE，来自 8 个语言模型。作者考察的是 prompt transformation 引起的表示重分布是否能在留出变体上复现，以及这种复现能否解释冻结安全 readout 的变化。主要结果有三类。\n\n第一，RSS 选出的支持集在 held-out variants 上仍呈现可重复的 redistribution profile，说明它抓到的不是 selector 集上的偶然 feature 波动。第二，在两个冻结的 safety readout 审计任务上，虽然 RSS 选 support 时完全不看 readout 信息，但这些 support 仍能重建相当大一部分 held-out logit change，说明 recurrent representation change 与下游读出确实存在稳定联系。第三，把 RSS support 与 clean margin 结合后，可以较好地预测 recurrent failure。文中给出的数字是：两个任务上，median support size 分别为 20 和 19 个 feature，得到的 recurrent failure AUROC 分别为 0.935 和 0.958；而使用 full erosion 的 AUROC 为 0.965 和 0.964。这个差距不大，说明很小的 recurrent support 已经保留了大部分审计效用。\n\n从实验解读看，最有意思的不是 AUROC 本身，而是作者证明了“稳定表示变化”和“行为失败”之间并非一一对应：有些 vie","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-15T22:39:54Z","category_id":"mechanism","cover_url":"/covers/2610_22717.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解决的不是“某一步看起来像错了”，而是“这一步相对于此前已经建立的推理状态，到底错在什么关系上”。长链式推理里，重复、过早切换思路、无依据推出结论，往往都不能靠局部文本信号判断，因为同一句话在不同上下文里可能分别是必要推进、合理回溯，或纯粹空转。ARBOR把推理过程显式表示成一棵 很难区分真正有用的探索、合理回退和无效重复。ARBOR提供了一种更接近程序执行轨迹的标注框架：同一条轨迹可以被解析成确定性的状态演化，再把失败细分成与特定历史节点相关的子类型。这样的表示对后续几类问题都有启发：一是构造更干净的过程监督数据；二是分析长推理中的 token 浪费与正确率损失分别来自哪里；三是为 test-time intervention 提供更明确的触发条件。量级上，它更像一个高质量分析与标注框架，而不是新的训练范式，但如果要做 reasoning pretrain / mid-train / PRM 数据构建，这类工作是有实际接口价值的。","technical_approach":"方法分三段。第一段是 parser。作者先为每个任务定义 puzzle schema，包括实体、谓词、允许的操作、初始状态、目标等，再让 Qwen3.8-27B 把每个自然语言步骤解析成一个 operation 加 payload。operation 一共七类：Derive、Assume、Verify、Prune、Confirm、Restate、Meta。payload 是去表述差异后的规范化内容，比如事实、数值、动作、子目标、假设或答案。这样“Bob lives in the fifth house”和“house 5’s name is Bob”会落到同一个原子表示上。第二段是 deterministic engine。它不再调用模型，而是把 parser 输出按顺序回放到当前树状态上，解析该步骤应当附着到哪个节点，并执行相应 mutation。因为这一步是确定性的，所以同样的 parse 会得到同样的树和同样的 failure label。第三段是 failure attribution。作者不把 failure 定义成一句话本身的属性，而是定义成 predicate(step, resolved node, prior tree)。这样三大失败模式——repetition、underthinking、unsupported deduction——都能进一步拆成若干子类型，并且每个标签都能指出它是相对于哪个先前状态成立的。方法上的关键区别有两点：第一，它把“推理内容”与“推理操作”分开，先做 wording-invariant canonicalization，再做状态更新；第二，它把 failure 从文本分类问题改成状态机上的关系判定问题，因此能区分局部文本相似但功能不同的步骤。文中还强调，只有 parser 用到 LLM，后续 replay 和 labeling
